notes:
Reported success is the authors’ study-level narrative verdict.
Source follow-up: Original-only fresh validation. Source title and authors match the assigned original reference. This is the Journal of Consumer Research advance-access article published March 2, 2016, with pre-issue pagination; target results occur on its printed p. 8 and participant description on p. 7. No inference about final issue-version contents is made. The source reports ninety-three Study 1b participants but does not explicitly label a post-exclusion analytic N for this test; n.value is therefore null. Requested printed test statistic retained without conversion. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
